indicators.note: a composer puts things together, so the letters of the star are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A celebrity composer is accused of issuing intimidating warnings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composer' looks like the star's job, but it signals rearranging THE STAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Menaces are warnings of harm, the same as intimidations.

parts.note: trans. is the abbreviation for translated
it can mean a thing or article

explanation.surface: A passage is taken from a translated article.
explanation.definitionFit: Transit is passage from one place to another.

parts.note: a rule is a measuring stick
out means wrong, as in a guess being out

explanation.surface: Someone forbids a wrong measurement.
explanation.definitionFit: To exclude something is to bar it.

parts.note: the foot is the base of something

explanation.surface: A foundation for making beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brewing' looks like making beer; here it means in preparation, as in trouble brewing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something underway or being planned is said to be in the making.

clue.text: Depressing design, and quite out of place

indicators.note: letters quite out of place are thoroughly jumbled, signalling a rearrangement of design and

explanation.surface: A gloomy design, and wholly unsuitable for the room.
explanation.definitionFit: Making sad means depressing.

clue.text: Delay proceedings after set-back in Jerusalem

indicators.note: in says the turned word sits inside the name for Jerusalem

parts.note: Sion (Zion) is a poetic name for Jerusalem

indicators.note: back, joined to set in set-back, says the synonym for set is read backwards

parts.note: to set something down is to put it

explanation.surface: Hearings in Jerusalem are postponed after a setback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set-back' looks like a single noun meaning a reverse; its two halves do separate jobs, with 'back' turning the synonym for set before it goes in. Sion is a biblical name for Jerusalem.
explanation.definitionFit: To sit on a matter is to hold back action on it, stalling progress.

indicators.note: gathers means takes on, so the sun picks up the word for heat

parts.note: warm, as in warmth or heat

explanation.surface: People gather when the sunshine brings warmth.
explanation.definitionFit: To crowd together in a mass like bees is to congregate.

clue.text: Herb added to a strong Spanish wine

indicators.note: added to says the herb is followed by a

parts.note: tarragon is an aromatic herb

explanation.surface: A herb is added to a strong Spanish wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarragona is a strong sweet fortified wine from the Catalan province of that name.

clue.text: Piggish? It's a bad sign, they say

indicators.note: they say means spoken aloud, so the words are heard

parts.note: a bad sign is a poor sign

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that greed is an unfortunate omen.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken, a poor sign sounds like the adjective for pigs.
explanation.definitionFit: Porcine means pig-like, relating to swine.

indicators.note: constructed means built anew, so the letters of town and pre are put together in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A Welsh town built in advance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pre-constructed' looks like one word but pre is part of the fodder with town, and constructed signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A city and port on the River Usk in south-east Wales.

definitions.meaning: a phrase meaning entirely satisfactory, nothing amiss
an old name for Good King Henry, a leafy herb of the goosefoot family

explanation.surface: Someone praises the ideal specimen for a garden.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means wholly fine or flawless, and is also the folk name of a goosefoot herb.

indicators.note: after places the word for boasted behind the word for broadcast

parts.note: to air a programme is to broadcast it
crew is an old past tense of crow, to boast

explanation.surface: Pilots and cabin staff brag once a programme has gone out.
explanation.walkthrough: CREW as a past tense of crow (to boast) is old-fashioned but listed in dictionaries.
explanation.definitionFit: The staff who work on board a flight are literally personnel high in the sky.

definitions.meaning: a one-syllable word is a brief expression, read literally
temporary, lasting only for a while

explanation.surface: A dictionary entry asks for a one-syllable word that means temporary.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-syllable word is literally a brief term, and the phrase also means temporary or provisional.

clue.text: American and I leave Spanish friend

parts.note: American gives AM
to go is to leave

explanation.surface: An American and the speaker both depart, leaving their Spanish pal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish word for a companion or pal, widely used in English.

clue.text: Common root vegetable consumed in turkey

indicators.note: in places the word for consumed inside the abbreviation for turkey

parts.note: TR is the international vehicle code for Turkey
consumed means ate

explanation.surface: A humble vegetable gets eaten inside a roast bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turkey' reads as the Christmas bird, but it is the country, with vehicle code TR. 'Common' marks the answer as slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang or informal word for a potato, a starchy tuber.

clue.text: Eccentric man inside gets a twitch of arthritis

indicators.note: inside places the male pronoun within the word for eccentric

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd or eccentric
he refers to a man
a tic is a twitch

explanation.surface: An odd man gets a twitch from his arthritis.
explanation.walkthrough: RUM as an adjective means odd in British slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Rheumatic means relating to rheumatism, joint pain like arthritis.

clue.text: Interest retired man though he's self-absorbed

parts.note: int. is the abbreviation for interest

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn, going backwards, so the man's name is read in reverse

parts.note: Trevor is a man's name

explanation.surface: A retired man takes an interest in things even though he keeps to himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' turns TREVOR into ROVERT; the man's name is the solver's to find.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone turned inward on their own thoughts is withdrawn and inward-looking.

clue.text: Walk around with confidence if cherished

indicators.note: around says the word for walk goes round the other

parts.note: to tread is to walk
sure means confident

explanation.surface: Someone strides about with confidence if they feel loved.
explanation.definitionFit: Treasured means held dear, much loved.

parts.note: CO is a commanding officer
a league is an alliance

explanation.surface: An associate of an army officer deserts an alliance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' looks like a verb (departed), but it is just L.
explanation.definitionFit: A fellow worker or partner is an associate.

definitions.meaning: a privateer or sea-raider, especially of the Barbary coast
a vessel used by such raiders

explanation.definitionFit: A corsair was both a Barbary sea-raider and the vessel he sailed in.

clue.text: Many made money from being well-read

parts.note: L is 50 in Roman numerals, a large number
earned means made money

explanation.surface: Many people earned a living from being bookish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Many' for L (fifty) is a crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone well-read is scholarly and knowledgeable.

clue.text: A couple of hundred artist has for capital

parts.note: C is 100 in Roman numerals, so two hundred is CC
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter is paid a couple of hundred pounds for a city scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' sounds like money after 'a couple of hundred', but it is a capital city: that of Ghana.
explanation.definitionFit: Ghana's capital city.

definitions.meaning: a cupboard or chest of drawers
the body of senior ministers in a government

explanation.surface: Furniture used by government ministers.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabinet is a piece of furniture like a bureau, and also the senior ministers of a government.

definitions.meaning: at midday the morning (a.m.) is over, finished

explanation.definitionFit: Altered to remove errors; and split as a.m. ended, which happens at midday.

clue.text: Concerned with a lord mayor in Britain, say

parts.note: re means about or concerning
L is an abbreviation for lord
M is an abbreviation for mayor

explanation.surface: Something to do with a Lord Mayor in Britain, for example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lord mayor' looks like one title, but it gives two abbreviations, L and M.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain is an example of a kingdom or domain ruled by a monarch.

parts.note: a miser is a skinflint
having an alert mind makes one able, capable

explanation.surface: A sharp-witted skinflint is a gloomy figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone wretched and unhappy is gloomy.

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for monsieur
used means exploited

explanation.surface: Someone reflects on a Frenchman who was taken advantage of.
explanation.definitionFit: Mused means pondered or reflected.

indicators.note: anyway hints that the word reads the same either way, forwards or backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Someone decides to escalate the matter regardless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anyway' reads as an afterthought, but it says the letters read the same in any direction.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass a matter up to someone more senior for a decision.

clue.text: A pair of poles made eats — the first-fruits

parts.note: N is the north pole, so a pair of poles is NN

indicators.note: made, as in made up or remade, says eats is rearranged

explanation.surface: Two poles were made into a meal at the harvest festival.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' signals rearranging EATS into ATES. A pair of N poles is a crossword liberty: N stands for north.
explanation.definitionFit: Annates were a year's revenue of a church benefice paid to the Pope, known as first-fruits.

parts.note: re- is a prefix meaning again
fined means penalised

explanation.surface: Someone is penalised a second time for being too sophisticated.
explanation.definitionFit: Polished and well-bred, the same as cultured.

clue.text: Furious about Italian leader being demoted

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for furious goes round the leader

parts.note: seeing red means furious, so red stands for it
Il Duce was Mussolini's title, Italian for leader

explanation.surface: Someone is enraged that the Italian leader has been demoted.
explanation.definitionFit: Brought down in rank, as a demoted officer is.

clue.text: Lowered tax after seeing rodent in action

indicators.note: in places the rodent inside the word for action

parts.note: a deed is an action
a rat is a rodent

explanation.surface: A tax is cut once a rat is spotted in action.
explanation.walkthrough: To derate is to reduce the rates (local property tax) charged on a property.
explanation.definitionFit: Rates are a British property tax; cutting them reduces the levy.
